name: Amamiya Kanon
source:
One of Takumi's childhood friends. Plays the viola. Lived with Takumi for a time due to an incident in the past. One year older than Takumi.
[spoiler]Her parents died in the same accident as Mio's father and since then she couldn't express any emotions.[/spoiler]
